technical_and_design_decisions: Extend the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow (s-c-d), Spring XD, and spring-cloud-stream codebases rather than building greenfield components; keep the established technology stack of those projects (Java 8, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Maven/Gradle builds).

U1: Implement composed jobs on top of Spring Batch; aggregate progress by traversing child JobExecution/StepExecution data via the JobExplorer and expose an aggregated progress metric through a REST endpoint consumed by the admin UI.
U1: Implement the aggregated progress bar in the existing AngularJS-based admin UI, reusing the established job-monitoring views.

U2: Implement restart by re-launching the composed job definition and resuming each child job from its last failed or incomplete execution using Spring Batch restart semantics; expose restart through the existing REST controller, shell command, and UI action.

U3: Treat Kafka 0.9 integration as a time-boxed spike; deliver a compatibility/performance assessment plus prototype binder changes against the new consumer/producer APIs, not a production-ready binder.
U4: Treat Lattice infrastructure work as a time-boxed spike; deliver Vagrant/bootstrap scripts and a documented options analysis for bare-metal deployment, not a supported deployer.

U5: Implement dot-delimited property resolution in spring-cloud-stream's binding layer so Tuple and JSON payload properties can be addressed with dotted paths; keep backward compatibility with existing map-style access.

U6: Build tab completion on Spring Shell; expose module option metadata (configuration properties) from the server and implement completion providers that resolve module names, properties, and values at the shell prompt.
U7: Implement Mesos deployment as a new ModuleDeployer SPI implementation that submits applications to Marathon via its REST API using Docker container images.

U8: Extract the Redis JUnit @Rule test fixture into a new standalone GitHub repository with its own build, publish it as a Maven artifact, and update dependent projects to consume it from the repository.
assumptions: One experienced developer performs all work; estimates are person-effort in workdays, not elapsed duration.
Developer is already familiar with the Spring XD / Spring Cloud Data Flow / spring-cloud-stream codebases; no significant ramp-up time is required.
Existing development infrastructure is available: GitHub repositories, CI servers, artifact repositories, and build tooling.
Test infrastructure can be provisioned locally or in a lab: an Apache Kafka 0.9 cluster, a Mesos/Marathon test cluster, and a Vagrant-based Lattice environment.
U3 and U4 are investigation spikes; their deliverables are findings reports, prototypes, and scripts rather than production features.
Module option metadata (e.g., from spring-configuration-metadata) is available or can be generated to drive shell tab completion.
No changes are required to the external systems themselves (Kafka, Mesos, Marathon, Lattice, Redis).
Unit testing effort is included within each story's test activities; cross-story integration and system testing is a separate increment-level activity.
Documentation means reference documentation updates, Javadoc, and release notes; no formal training material is required.

The generic Spring Framework background in the specification (including Java 17 requirements for Spring Framework 6) is contextual; the increment targets the component versions referenced by the stories (e.g., Kafka 0.9 era codebases).

activities.activity_name: Increment requirements analysis and architecture alignment
activities.activity_description: Analyze all eight user stories, align on overall architecture and design approach across stories, identify dependencies between stories (e.g., U1/U2 both touch composed jobs), and define acceptance criteria.

activities.activity_name: Cross-story integration testing and hardening
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end integration testing across all delivered stories in a shared environment, fix integration defects, and stabilize the increment for release.

activities.activity_name: Documentation, release notes, and packaging
activities.activity_description: Update reference documentation and Javadoc for new features (composed job progress/restart, tab completion, Mesos deployer, dot-delimited properties), write release notes, and prepare release artifacts.

activities.activity_name: U1 design: composed job progress aggregation model
activities.activity_description: Design how progress of embedded child jobs is aggregated into a single progress value, including the traversal of child job/step executions and the REST representation.

activities.activity_name: U1 backend: aggregation service and REST endpoint
activities.activity_description: Implement the server-side service that computes aggregated progress for a composed job from child JobExecution data and expose it via a REST endpoint.

activities.activity_name: U1 UI: aggregated progress bar
activities.activity_description: Implement the aggregated progress bar in the admin UI job views, wired to the new REST endpoint, including polling/refresh behavior.

activities.activity_name: U1 tests
activities.activity_description: Write unit and integration tests covering aggregation logic, the REST endpoint, and UI behavior for composed jobs with varying child job states.

activities.activity_name: U2 design: composed job restart semantics
activities.activity_description: Define restart semantics for composed jobs: how to determine which child jobs to re-run, how to resume failed child executions, and the resulting state transitions.

activities.activity_name: U2 backend: restart support in job controller and service
activities.activity_description: Implement restart of an existing composed job in the job execution service and REST controller, re-launching it on demand and resuming child jobs appropriately.

activities.activity_name: U2 shell and UI: restart command exposure
activities.activity_description: Expose the composed job restart capability through the shell command and the admin UI action.

activities.activity_name: U2 tests
activities.activity_description: Write unit and integration tests for restart scenarios including successful, partially failed, and repeated restarts of composed jobs.

activities.activity_name: U3 spike: provision Kafka 0.9 test environment
activities.activity_description: Set up a local/lab Apache Kafka 0.9 cluster (with Zookeeper) suitable for compatibility and performance experiments.

activities.activity_name: U3 spike: Kafka 0.9 compatibility assessment and prototype
activities.activity_description: Investigate integration options with Kafka 0.9, assess the new consumer/producer APIs and security features, run compatibility and basic performance tests, and prototype binder changes to identify improvement areas.

activities.activity_name: U3 spike: findings report
activities.activity_description: Document findings, identified improvement areas, risks, and recommended follow-up work for Kafka 0.9 integration.

activities.activity_name: U4 spike: research Lattice and provision local environment
activities.activity_description: Research Lattice concepts, APIs, and deployment model; provision a local Lattice environment (e.g., Vagrant-based) for experimentation.

activities.activity_name: U4 spike: prototype bootstrap scripts for bare-metal Lattice deployment
activities.activity_description: Explore and prototype bootstrap/setup scripts and configuration needed to stand up Lattice-based infrastructure for s-c-d bare-metal deployment.

activities.activity_name: U4 spike: document findings and options
activities.activity_description: Document the explored options, prototype results, limitations, and recommended approach for Lattice-based bare-metal deployment.

activities.activity_name: U5 design: dot-delimited property resolution semantics
activities.activity_description: Define the syntax and resolution semantics for dot-delimited property paths targeting Tuple and JSON payloads in stream definitions, including escaping and backward compatibility rules.

activities.activity_name: U5 implementation: property resolution in spring-cloud-stream
activities.activity_description: Implement dot-delimited property path resolution for Tuple and JSON in the spring-cloud-stream binding/property handling code.

activities.activity_name: U5 tests
activities.activity_description: Write unit and integration tests covering nested paths, special characters, missing properties, and regression coverage for existing property handling.

activities.activity_name: U6 design: completion model and options metadata exposure
activities.activity_description: Design the tab completion model: which commands and contexts are completable (module names, option names, option values) and how the server exposes module option metadata.

activities.activity_name: U6 backend: module options metadata endpoint
activities.activity_description: Implement the server-side endpoint/service that provides module option metadata used to drive shell completion.

activities.activity_name: U6 shell: tab-completion implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement tab completion in the Spring Shell-based s-c-d shell, including completion providers for stream definitions, module names, and their available options.

activities.activity_name: U6 tests
activities.activity_description: Write unit and integration tests for completion providers, metadata endpoint, and representative shell interaction scenarios.

activities.activity_name: U7 design: Mesos deployer approach
activities.activity_description: Design the Mesos deployment approach: ModuleDeployer SPI implementation, use of Marathon REST API, containerization strategy, and mapping of module deployment properties.

activities.activity_name: U7 implementation: Mesos module deployer
activities.activity_description: Implement the Mesos/Marathon module deployer including application submission, scaling, status reporting, and undeployment; validate against a Mesos/Marathon test cluster.

activities.activity_name: U7 tests and acceptance
activities.activity_description: Write unit tests for the deployer, run acceptance tests deploying sample streams on a Mesos cluster, and fix defects.

activities.activity_name: U8: extract Redis @Rule into a separate repository
activities.activity_description: Create the new repository, move the Redis JUnit @Rule test fixture code, set up its standalone build and artifact publishing.

activities.activity_name: U8: migrate dependent projects and verify CI
activities.activity_description: Update consuming projects to depend on the published fixture artifact instead of the embedded code, and verify builds and tests pass in CI.
